findings.message: No JSON-LD block in the post.
Price is not published in the ficha.
Carrier is not listed as accepted in the ficha.

findings.why: Fillings wear, stain, loosen and need replacement, which the post itself says later, and ADA/NIDCR guidance says no filling lasts forever; this is also an implied guarantee.
findings.fix: Replace with 'Tooth-colored fillings can last many years, but they may eventually need repair or replacement.'

findings.why: The ficha lists no filling price; only $129 exam/x-rays, $395 whitening and $95 emergency exam may appear.
findings.fix: Delete the price and tell readers to call (512) 555-0142 for an estimate.

findings.why: Aetna is not in the accepted insurance list (Delta Dental, Cigna, MetLife), so this is a false claim about coverage.
findings.fix: Remove it or name only Delta Dental, Cigna and MetLife, and advise readers to confirm their plan with the office.

findings.quote: Tooth color does not mean the material will remain unchanged forever.
findings.why: This sentence is accurate and contradicts the earlier 'last forever' claim, which makes the inconsistency obvious.
findings.fix: Keep this sentence and fix the earlier claim.

findings.quote: no single material is the best choice for every situation
findings.why: This is a hedged statement, not an unsupported superlative, so no action is needed.

findings.quote: A dental exam is the best way to discuss your particular tooth and the available options.
findings.why: 'Best way' is a mild generic superlative, though it is reasonable advice and does not refer to the clinic's quality.
findings.fix: Optionally soften to 'A dental exam is a good way to discuss...'.

findings.quote: Composite is placed in layers and hardened with a special light.
findings.why: This is consistent with mainstream dental guidance, and the sources listed plausibly support it, but I could not open the links to confirm their URLs or content.
findings.fix: Check that the three source URLs resolve before publishing.

findings.quote: [National Institute of Dental and Craniofacial Research: Dental Fillings](https://www.nidcr.nih.gov/health-info/dental-fillings)
findings.why: I cannot verify that this URL exists; NIDCR's actual page paths may differ, and I will not assume it resolves.
findings.fix: Open each of the three source links and replace any that return an error with working pages.

findings.quote: Bluebonnet Hollow Dental offers tooth-colored fillings.
findings.why: No JSON-LD block was included in the post, so the structured data cannot be checked against the visible text.
findings.fix: Supply the JSON-LD and confirm that name, address, phone, hours and any price match the ficha.
